name: benchmark-nanoquoraretrieval
description: A retrieval benchmark built around NanoQuora-style question/answer pairs intended to evaluate retrieval and ranking methods for finding relevant Q&A passages. It measures how well systems retrieve relevant documents or candidate answers given a query and is designed for evaluating lightweight or research retrieval stacks. The dataset is primarily targeted at text-only retrieval scenarios.
reputation: A niche / research-stage dataset with limited but growing use in retrieval experiments.
